presentation.label: Two more MIDI CC controls
presentation.summary: Two extra CC controls, numeric headers, saved track names, and a one-time Bank A project setup.
presentation.overview: Midi Mode 2 adds two CC controls per MIDI track and numeric headers. F at NAME/PUSH opens the stock ten-character editor. Set Bank A / Part 1 names and channels, save the project normally, then hold FUNC and push D at INIT (FN+ / PUSH). Progress shows the bank being checked or written; NO cancels safely. Initialization happens once, then each bank keeps independent names and native channels. Save to New carries names and the completed marker.
highlights: Two additional CC positions per MIDI track when PB and AT are both mapped.
Independent CC0–127 assignments for the A and B positions.
Numeric CC headers on both MIDI CONTROL pages.
Restore pitch bend or aftertouch with a click in SETUP.
Initialize a project once from Bank A, keep independent bank names and channels, and carry names through Save to New.
usage: Select a MIDI track and double-tap FX1 to open MIDI CONTROL 1 SETUP.
Click A or B to switch its PB or AT position into CC mode. Turn to choose CC0–127, then press YES.
Press FX1 to return. Enable the value with FUNC + encoder press and turn it to send values on the track’s output channel.
Click again in SETUP to restore native behavior. Entering CC mode starts at CC0.
Double-tap SRC on a MIDI track, click F (NAME/PUSH), enter up to ten characters and confirm with YES or cancel with NO.
Back up a disposable project. Set Bank A / Part 1 names and channels, stop transport and recorders, and save the project normally.

In MIDI SRC SETUP, hold FUNC and push D at INIT (FN+ / PUSH). No typing is needed. Watch the bank progress and wait for MIDI SETUP SAVED; NO cancels at a safe boundary. Legacy saved name/channel overrides are retained.
After INIT, name or channel edits stay in their own banks. Save channel edits normally; wait for MIDI PROFILE SAVED after name edits. Save to New carries names and the marker.

controls.name: A mode
controls.doc: Click encoder A in CONTROL 1 SETUP to switch pitch bend to CC. Entering CC mode starts at CC0.

controls.name: B mode
controls.doc: Click encoder B in CONTROL 1 SETUP to switch aftertouch to CC, independently of A.

controls.name: CC assignment
controls.doc: In CC mode, turn the corresponding SETUP encoder to select CC0–127 and confirm with YES.

controls.name: A value
controls.doc: On CONTROL 1, enable the value with FUNC + encoder press, then turn its encoder to send 0–127. The displayed assignment is separate from the value. A retains the current pitch-bend position’s value; a fresh project starts at 64.

controls.name: B value
controls.doc: On CONTROL 1, enable the value with FUNC + encoder press, then turn its encoder to send 0–127. The displayed assignment is separate from the value. B retains the current aftertouch position’s value; a fresh project starts at 0.

controls.name: Track name
controls.doc: Click F in MIDI NOTE SETUP. Ten characters; YES confirms, NO cancels. Names autosave while stopped and are shared by Parts within each bank. Before INIT, unedited banks inherit Bank A; INIT freezes independent snapshots.

controls.name: Apply project setup
controls.doc: Save the project first. Hold FUNC and click D in MIDI NOTE SETUP to apply Bank A / Part 1 once. Plain D shows a hint. NO cancels at a safe boundary; progress shows checking, applying or restoring. A failure retains a diagnostic code; completed projects refuse reapplication.

access.location: MIDI track → double-tap FX1 → MIDI CONTROL 1 SETUP. A and B switch PB/AT to CC.
steps: Select a MIDI track and set its output channel for your receiving instrument.
Double-tap FX1 to open CONTROL 1 SETUP. Click A or B to switch its mode to CC.
Turn the corresponding encoder to choose CC0–127, then press YES.
Press FX1 to return to CONTROL 1. Enable its value with FUNC + encoder press, then turn it.
Press FX2 for CONTROL 2; both pages show assigned controller numbers.
Return to CONTROL 1 SETUP and click a mapped encoder again to restore its native PB or AT function.
Double-tap SRC: F opens NAME. Save the project normally, then hold FUNC and click D at INIT (FN+ / PUSH). No typed confirmation. NO cancels safely; wait for MIDI SETUP SAVED.

limitations: Local experimental USB draft. Requires loader ABI 8, at least 24 sites and 24 stock copies; public shared lifecycle events and hardware qualification remain pending.

Back up the full project before Apply. Save normally first; both saved bank copies must be valid and current. Initialize before new bank-specific migration edits because legacy saved overrides remain authoritative.
Names and marker use MIDI4_0.DAT / MIDI4_1.DAT; recovery uses MIDI4_J0.DAT / MIDI4_J1.DAT. Keep all sidecars with backups. Existing MIDI3_*.DAT and MIDI2_*.DAT import read-only and remain unchanged.

Apply changes native bank files once; Undo/removal does not reverse completed project edits. Progress yields between bank pairs. NO cancels at a safe boundary; live failure rolls back in place without automatic reload. Boot recovery may reload after restoring files. Loss of both verified peers requires backup recovery.
After INIT, channel changes use normal project/bank saves; bank changes and restart never remap defaults. Names remain shared across Parts in a bank.

The user clarified that 0.0.9 completed Apply, Bank B MIDI track 6 used channel 6, and controls returned after more than ten seconds. This follow-up allows bare page browsing and reduces CRC work without dropping verification. Physical timing, full resident dispatch, restart and broader coexistence of 0.0.11 remain unqualified.
Switching back into CC mode starts at CC0 rather than recalling its previous number.

storage.label: Runtime package
storage.conditions: Package bytes and image size measured from the verified relocatable package. Runtime loader metadata and copied stock spans add allocation overhead.

processing.label: ColdFire control processing
processing.conditions: Emulator and source checks do not measure physical CPU load or timing headroom.

impact.conditions: Source estimates for a small MIDI/UI adapter; no physical worst-case timing or load measurement.

cpu.rationale: Apply and rollback yield between bank pairs. Bank CRC verification uses one table lookup per byte instead of two; all original file checks remain. Bare page browsing and NO are allowed. Physical elapsed time and chip load remain unmeasured.

dsp.rationale: No authored DSP program or DSP effect slot is added.

memory.rationale: A 28,196-byte image includes names, journal buffers, a runtime-generated byte CRC table and touched-bank recovery state. Package size is 32,462 bytes; loader metadata adds overhead. Four 4,096-byte sidecars hold names/marker and journal checkpoints.

tests.summary: Exact 0.0.11 UI capture and native Apply/cancel/copy/restart checks; INIT is centered under CHAN with FN+ / PUSH inside encoder D’s cell. This changes only setup drawing; prior 0.0.10 regression evidence remains version-bound. Physical timing and exact installed identity remain unmeasured.
gates: 353 exact-build native Apply, bare FX1 page view, NO cancellation, checksum/non-channel preservation, independent edits, Save to New and fresh-process assertions
Exact-build two-placement guarded reconstruction and strict 16-byte stock-overlap scan
Two exact-build native INIT/progress screenshots; older naming/CC images retain their original provenance
Earlier 0.0.10 CC, recovery, channel-6 output, NAME retirement and loader evidence stays bound to that version in TESTING.md; storage, channel and key-handler sources are unchanged in 0.0.11
